help.title: Quick guide
help.subtitle: How to use multiple Zalo accounts safely and handle common situations.

mentalModel.title: 1. What this app does (and doesn't do)
mentalModel.body: KHOANG creates separate data spaces so you can run multiple Zalo Desktop windows side by side. It does not register new Zalo accounts and never asks for or stores your passwords, OTP codes, or messages.

signIn.title: 2. Adding and signing in to an account
signIn.body: Click Add account, pick a memorable name (such as Work or Sales) and color, then click Open Zalo to sign in directly inside the Zalo Desktop window via QR code or password.

windowState.title: 3. Window status & main Zalo protection
windowState.body: "Window open" means the Zalo window is running on your computer — it does not assume you are signed in inside Zalo. Your existing main Zalo installation always stays untouched and cannot be closed or removed here.

commonIssues.title: 4. Common issues & known limits
commonIssues.body:
• Cannot open Zalo: make sure official Zalo Desktop is installed on this computer.
• Cannot back up or remove: click Close Zalo on that account card first.
• Duplicate account warning: avoid signing in to the same Zalo account in two windows at once.
• Voice/video call limit: Zalo Desktop shares a system call channel, so simultaneous calls across multiple windows may be limited.

help.title: How KHOANG works
items: Each account you add opens Zalo Desktop in its own separate space.
You sign in directly inside Zalo (QR or password); KHOANG never collects credentials.
Any Zalo already installed on your computer stays untouched and protected.
You can back up any account whenever its Zalo window is closed.
